text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I entered the trainer's office, 
Mejiro Ardan was gazing out the window 
with a melancholic expression.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Good day to you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize. It's a trivial matter... 
really quite trivial, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"The other day, I ordered both volumes of 
a book I've wanted to read online, and—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When I opened the package... the first 
volume was the old edition, and the second 
volume was the new edition. It looks so 
odd when lined up on the bookshelf...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Perhaps I should not have been 
lazy and visited the bookstore myself to 
buy it on foot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan let out a sigh, looking 
visibly troubled...
